args.title: Add remembering last export format in ExportButton component
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add functionality to remember the last export format chosen by the user in the browser (e.g., using localStorage) and initialize the export format select menu to that value on component load, rather than defaulting to CSV every time. This improves usability by avoiding accidental exports in unintended formats.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export format select box always reverts to CSV on loading a report, which can cause accidental exports to the wrong format. The ExportButton component is responsible for this. Adding state persistence in this file to remember the last chosen export format in the browser will address the request.
